abilities.name: Digimon Queen
abilities.description: Once per round, when your partner Digimon deals enough damage in a single hit to reduce a target to 0 HP, they may immediately make one additional attack, using their Basic Action a second time this round.

abilities.name: Undisputed
abilities.description: Whenever your partner Digimon defeats an enemy, they gain +2 to all hit and damage rolls for the remainder of the encounter. This stacks each time they defeat another enemy in the same encounter.

abilities.name: Relentless
abilities.description: Digimon Queen loses its once per round restriction. Your partner Digimon can trigger it every time they defeat a target with a single hit, no matter how many times that happens in a round.

abilities.name: Blunt Force
abilities.description: When your partner Digimon lands a hit, you may choose to forgo any status effect tags on that attack. If you do, deal +2 additional damage instead.

abilities.name: Every Fall Counts
abilities.description: Digimon Queen now triggers whenever any Digimon is defeated in the encounter, not just when your own partner Digimon lands the finishing blow.

abilities.name: Sharper Eye
abilities.description: Your partner Digimon's attacks now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18, 19, or 20, not just a natural 20.
